Guardian emergency is active. Location permission is off, so only a heartbeat is being sent.

Guardian reads the volume buttons so you can start an SOS without opening the screen. Guardian does not block the volume buttons, does not read other apps, and does not hide itself. You can turn this off in Android accessibility settings.
